subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor RFC 27's core `claws add` lifecycle and land this mutation/provenance slice after the read-only base PR?
rationale: This adds a new experimental core CLI workflow and authoritative persisted lifecycle model; implementation review cannot decide whether that product surface and multi-PR ownership stack should become a supported OpenClaw direction.

options.title: Sponsor ordered landing
options.body: Approve the RFC direction, require the open base PR to land first, obtain real interrupted-retry proof, and then review this slice against the resulting main head.

options.title: Hold the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the mutation series paused until maintainers narrow or reject the RFC's core lifecycle and persistence ownership.
